data.body:
[P2] Preserve the originating operation when multiple failures match

When a map allows two items to fail, `BatchResult.throwIfError()` throws the first failed item by index. If their steps throw `PaymentError("x")` and `RefundError("x")`, both item checkpoints contain `StepError("x")`. This lookup selects the latest-ending item, so an execution propagating the first item's `PaymentError` can be reported as `RefundError`. Retain the originating operation's identity, or decline ambiguous matches instead of treating completion time as provenance. Add coverage with sequential map items and sufficient failure tolerance for both to finish.
